newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips open slightly softer, techs firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips open slightly softer, techs firm.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks opened slightly weaker on Monday but technology stocks firmed going into the start of a week heavy with key economic data.
The Dow Industrials opened off 4.41 at 8,109.03. The Nasdaq Composite rose 3.39 to 1,572.97, while the S&P Index was up 0.66 at 939.45.
The 30-year long bond rose 4/32 to yield 6.45 percent yield.
